notes:
A common term in art, design, photography, cosmetics, and hairstyling. Describes the quality that makes flat representations appear three-dimensional, or that gives physical objects a pleasing sense of volume and depth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立体感|りったいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have depth/dimension
- {立体感|りったいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to create a sense of depth
- {立体感|りったいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give dimension
- {立体感|りったいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧: hairstyle with volume
- {立体感|りったいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧: painting with depth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奥行|おくゆ}き→奥行き：10569_okuyuki⟧: depth — physical depth or the impression of depth in space
- ⟦{臨場感|りんじょうかん}→臨場感：06251_rinjoukan⟧: sense of being there, presence — the feeling of being immersed in a scene
- ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧: three-dimensional — the base noun describing 3D objects themselves

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧ (three-dimensional body) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense).

definitions.explanation: the visual or tactile impression that something has depth and dimension rather than being flat; the quality of appearing three-dimensional

examples.english: This painting has a sense of depth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{立体感|りったいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
